items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I told him about the drummer, Bob Rand, Bonnie Big Eye. I told him about them. So they come up and Joe sent for them.

ctx.x: Yeah, and where was your job?

Yeah, they was working down there and there. Where was Joe playing then? Joe was playing in Lincoln Garden. Lincoln Garden. Louis was working at the Dreamland, and joined the band at the Dreamland. I mean Lil was working there together. So I come to Chicago and I joined Joe's band. Well Joe had George Fields and he had a big band. He had the kind of band that he had now. He had a corner player playing with a man by the name of Bob Schaffner. He went later to the plantation with Dave Payton. So with the band…
So I said, when did y'all go home?

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Lee Collins told me he used to do a lot of scat singing.

ctx.x: I mean Bolton was his last name. I don't know. Let's see if I can call his name. I didn't know it. Happy Bolton. I don't know his name was Bolton Bure or whatever you want. Lee Collins told me he used to do a lot of scat singing. He was a rock band. Yeah, he did a lot of scat singing. Yeah, he was a sensational drummer. He was a sensational drummer. He was uncool though. He'd come and pick up your stick. Give me a stick. You don't know what you're doing. You might play something. Just like that. You know, just…
You know, just take your stick out there. That's right. You know, just take your stick out there. That's right. You know, I didn't know it.
